cement-board-ventilated-facades.summary: CE-certified lightweight cement board for CBSS and CBMV ventilated facade systems across all European climate zones.

cement-board-ventilated-facades.h1: Cement Board for Ventilated Facade Systems
cement-board-ventilated-facades.lead: Terasun TSM is the specified facade board in CBSS and CBMV ventilated cladding systems for new build and refurbishment across Europe.
cement-board-ventilated-facades.body1: Ventilated facade systems are the standard for high-performance building envelopes across Northern, Central, and Southern Europe. The cement board acts as the outer cladding skin mounted on a rail and bracket substructure with a ventilated air cavity behind. Terasun TSM is specified in CBSS (continuous bracket support) and CBMV (metal rail ventilated) facade systems.
cement-board-ventilated-facades.body2: At 9.96 kg/m² at 12 mm, Terasun TSM is significantly lighter than natural stone (40–60 kg/m²), terracotta (35–45 kg/m²), or ceramic tile alternatives, reducing dead load on the substructure — a critical factor in refurbishment projects with limited structural capacity.

cement-board-ventilated-facades.feature2: EN 12467 Category A — moisture and climate classified for all European zones
cement-board-ventilated-facades.feature3: CE certificate 1023-CPR-1565 P — mandatory for EEA construction use
cement-board-ventilated-facades.feature4: Accepts mineral silicate paint, silicone render, and acrylic finishes
cement-board-ventilated-facades.feature5: Open-jointed or sealed joint system compatible
cement-board-ventilated-facades.feature6: ETA 24/0895 confirms performance for facade applications

cement-board-exterior-plaster.lead: Terasun TSM cement board is used as a render carrier substrate (plaster backing board) in exterior wall systems, providing a dimensionally stable, moisture-resistant base for mineral and silicone render finishes.
cement-board-exterior-plaster.body1: In direct-render facade applications, the cement board is fixed directly to the wall framing or masonry substrate and acts as the backing for an external render system. Mineral silicate render, silicone render, and acrylic thin-coat render systems are compatible with the cement board surface after priming.
cement-board-exterior-plaster.body2: Unlike timber sheathing boards or gypsum-based backing, Terasun TSM does not absorb moisture or degrade when exposed to wind-driven rain during the construction phase — reducing the risk of render failure caused by substrate movement.
cement-board-exterior-plaster.feature1: Dimensionally stable — no swelling or shrinkage when wetted during render application
cement-board-exterior-plaster.feature2: Provides excellent render adhesion after alkali-resistant primer
cement-board-exterior-plaster.feature3: Compatible with Sto, Baumit, Weber, and Mapei render systems
cement-board-exterior-plaster.feature4: Category A moisture classification — suitable for all European climates
cement-board-exterior-plaster.feature5: Non-combustible substrate — A1 reaction to fire
cement-board-exterior-plaster.feature6: CE certified under EN 12467 — mandatory for EEA use

cement-board-wet-rooms.title: Cement board for wet rooms
cement-board-wet-rooms.summary: Moisture-resistant cement board substrate for wet rooms, shower enclosures, and water-exposed tile applications.
cement-board-wet-rooms.metaTitle: Cement Board for Wet Rooms | Tile Backer Board | Terasun TSM
cement-board-wet-rooms.metaDesc: Terasun TSM moisture-resistant cement board for wet rooms, shower walls, and tile backing. Used in Mapei and Schönox approved systems. EN 12467 Category A.
cement-board-wet-rooms.h1: Cement Board for Wet Rooms and Shower Enclosures
cement-board-wet-rooms.lead: Terasun TSM is used as the tile backing substrate in wet room and shower enclosure applications, providing a dimensionally stable, moisture-resistant base for tiled wall and floor systems.
cement-board-wet-rooms.body1: Terasun TSM cement board is approved as a tile backing substrate in Mapei and Schönox wet room systems. The board itself provides moisture resistance (EN 12467 Category A) — it does not absorb water or degrade in persistently wet conditions. However, the board is not a waterproof barrier on its own: a waterproof tanking membrane must be applied over the board before tiling in shower and wet room applications.
cement-board-wet-rooms.body2: In wet room floor applications, TSM cement board over a concrete screed provides a stable, non-swelling substrate for the tanking membrane and tile finish. Unlike timber substrates or gypsum board, cement board does not flex, swell, or promote mould growth when exposed to persistent moisture.
cement-board-wet-rooms.feature1: EN 12467 Category A — highest moisture classification for cement boards
cement-board-wet-rooms.feature2: Approved substrate in Mapei and Schönox wet room tile systems
cement-board-wet-rooms.feature3: Dimensionally stable — no swelling or warping in persistently wet conditions
cement-board-wet-rooms.feature4: Suitable for shower enclosures, wet room floors, and bathroom walls
cement-board-wet-rooms.feature5: Low mould risk — inorganic cement matrix provides no food for biological growth
cement-board-wet-rooms.feature6: Must be used with an approved waterproof tanking membrane before tiling

cement-board-bathrooms.title: Cement board for bathrooms
cement-board-bathrooms.summary: Cement board substrate for bathroom tile walls, shower enclosures, and moisture-exposed wall and floor applications.
cement-board-bathrooms.metaTitle: Cement Board for Bathrooms | Shower Wall Board | Terasun TSM
cement-board-bathrooms.metaDesc: Terasun TSM cement board for bathroom and shower wall tile backing. Moisture stable, EN 12467 Category A, approved in Mapei and Schönox wet room systems.
cement-board-bathrooms.h1: Cement Board for Bathroom and Shower Wall Applications
cement-board-bathrooms.lead: Terasun TSM provides a stable, moisture-resistant substrate for tiled bathroom walls and shower enclosures — a superior alternative to moisture-resistant gypsum board in high-humidity and splash-zone applications.
cement-board-bathrooms.body1: Standard moisture-resistant gypsum board (MR gypsum) is often used in bathrooms, but it is not suitable for direct shower splash zones or floor applications. Terasun TSM cement board is classified EN 12467 Category A — the highest moisture classification — and does not degrade, swell, or develop mould in persistently wet bathroom conditions.
cement-board-bathrooms.body2: For shower enclosures where direct water contact occurs, a waterproof tanking membrane (liquid-applied or sheet) must be applied over the cement board before tiling. The board + membrane + tile system provides full waterproofing — the board alone is moisture resistant but not waterproof.
cement-board-bathrooms.feature1: Superior to MR gypsum — does not degrade in bathroom splash zones
cement-board-bathrooms.feature3: No mould risk — inorganic cement composition
cement-board-bathrooms.feature4: High impact resistance for towel rail and fixture fixings
cement-board-bathrooms.feature5: Suitable as shower enclosure tile backer with waterproof membrane
cement-board-bathrooms.feature6: Approved in Mapei and Schönox bathroom system specifications

fire-rated-cement-board-wall-system.title: Fire-rated cement board wall system
fire-rated-cement-board-wall-system.summary: Tested fire-rated wall assembly using Terasun TSM cement board — E 120 / EI 90 / EW 120 classification.
fire-rated-cement-board-wall-system.metaTitle: Fire Rated Cement Board Wall System | E120 EI90 | Terasun TSM
fire-rated-cement-board-wall-system.metaDesc: Terasun TSM in fire-rated wall assemblies achieving E 120 / EI 90 / EW 120. Non-combustible A1. CE certified. Fire test FIRES-CR-284-25-AUPE.
fire-rated-cement-board-wall-system.h1: Fire-Rated Wall System with Cement Board
fire-rated-cement-board-wall-system.lead: The tested wall assembly using Terasun TSM 12 mm cement board achieves E 120 / EI 90 / EW 120 — exceeding typical gypsum wall system performance for fire partitions and compartmentation.
fire-rated-cement-board-wall-system.body1: Terasun TSM cement board has a reaction to fire classification of A1 — non-combustible per EN 13501-1. The fire resistance of the wall assembly (E 120 / EI 90 / EW 120) was established by fire test FIRES-CR-284-25-AUPE on a specific wall assembly. This classification belongs to the complete assembly — including the frame, insulation, board thickness, and fixing pattern — not to the board alone.
fire-rated-cement-board-wall-system.body2: For fire resistance classification to apply, the tested assembly must be replicated exactly. Substituting any component — including changing the board brand, thickness, or stud spacing — requires re-testing or engineering justification. Contact Terasun Europe for the full assembly specification and fire test report.
fire-rated-cement-board-wall-system.feature1: Reaction to fire: A1 — non-combustible per EN 13501-1
fire-rated-cement-board-wall-system.feature4: Tested assembly: EW 120 (integrity + radiation limitation 120 min)
fire-rated-cement-board-wall-system.feature6: Fire test report available on request or via partner portal

cement-board-steel-frame-construction.title: Cement board for steel frame
cement-board-steel-frame-construction.summary: Cement board cladding and sheathing for light steel frame and structural steel construction systems.

cement-board-steel-frame-construction.metaDesc: Terasun TSM cement board for light steel frame (LSF) and steel stud construction. Compatible with 400 mm and 600 mm stud spacing. CE certified, fire-rated system available.
cement-board-steel-frame-construction.h1: Cement Board for Steel Frame Construction
cement-board-steel-frame-construction.lead: Terasun TSM is used as exterior sheathing and interior cladding board in light steel frame (LSF) and structural steel frame construction systems across Europe.
cement-board-steel-frame-construction.body1: Steel frame construction requires an external sheathing board that is moisture stable, dimensionally stable, and non-combustible — all properties that cement board provides. Terasun TSM is compatible with both 400 mm and 600 mm stud spacing in light steel frame systems, making it directly interchangeable with gypsum sheathing in most wall assemblies.
cement-board-steel-frame-construction.body2: In steel frame facade systems, the cement board is fixed through the exterior insulation layer to the steel studs using corrosion-resistant screws. It provides the substrate for render finish, paintable cladding, or ventilated facade panels. In interior applications, it provides a high-impact, moisture-resistant alternative to standard gypsum lining board.

cement-board-steel-frame-construction.feature2: Compatible with 600 mm stud spacing for optimised steel frame systems
cement-board-steel-frame-construction.feature3: Non-combustible substrate — A1 reaction to fire
cement-board-steel-frame-construction.feature4: Dimensionally stable — no seasonal movement with humidity change
cement-board-steel-frame-construction.feature5: High impact resistance for commercial and industrial interiors
cement-board-steel-frame-construction.feature6: CE certified EN 12467 Category A — mandatory for EEA construction use

cement-board-modular-construction.title: Cement board for modular construction
cement-board-modular-construction.summary: Lightweight cement board for modular building systems — offsite manufactured, volumetric, and panelised construction.
cement-board-modular-construction.metaTitle: Cement Board for Modular Construction | Offsite Building Board | Terasun
cement-board-modular-construction.metaDesc: Terasun TSM lightweight cement board for modular and offsite construction. Moisture stable, non-combustible, CE certified. Suitable for volumetric and panelised systems.
cement-board-modular-construction.h1: Cement Board for Modular and Offsite Construction
cement-board-modular-construction.lead: Terasun TSM lightweight cement board is suited to modular building systems — its dimensional stability, non-combustibility, and moisture resistance make it appropriate for factory-manufactured modules and panelised wall systems.
cement-board-modular-construction.body1: Modular construction requires building boards that remain stable during factory assembly, transport, and installation — including exposure to weather during site installation. Terasun TSM cement board does not absorb moisture or lose structural integrity when exposed to rain, making it more suitable than gypsum board for modular units that cannot be fully protected during transport.
cement-board-modular-construction.body2: CE certification (1023-CPR-1565 P) under EN 12467 ensures that Terasun TSM meets the EU Construction Products Regulation requirements — essential for specifying products in public sector and commercial modular projects across Europe.

cement-board-modular-construction.feature2: Weather-resistant during transport and site assembly phases
cement-board-modular-construction.feature3: Non-combustible — meets fire requirements for modular residential and commercial
cement-board-modular-construction.feature4: CE certification supports procurement for public sector and residential projects
cement-board-modular-construction.feature5: EPD documentation supports BREEAM and LEED sustainability credits
cement-board-modular-construction.feature6: Available in pallet quantities for factory integration

cement-board-prefabricated-buildings.title: Cement board for prefabricated buildings
cement-board-prefabricated-buildings.summary: Cement board cladding and wall board for prefabricated building systems — portable buildings, relocatable units, and permanent prefab structures.
cement-board-prefabricated-buildings.metaTitle: Cement Board for Prefabricated Buildings | Terasun TSM
cement-board-prefabricated-buildings.metaDesc: Terasun TSM cement board for prefabricated and portable building systems. Moisture stable, non-combustible, CE-certified. Suitable for permanent and relocatable structures.
cement-board-prefabricated-buildings.h1: Cement Board for Prefabricated and Portable Buildings
cement-board-prefabricated-buildings.lead: Terasun TSM cement board is used in prefabricated building wall systems, providing moisture resistance, fire performance, and dimensional stability in both permanent and relocatable structures.
cement-board-prefabricated-buildings.body1: Prefabricated buildings — including modular offices, temporary accommodation, site cabins, and permanent prefab residential structures — require cladding and internal wall boards that perform reliably without on-site climatisation. Terasun TSM cement board is inert, dimensionally stable, and does not require the drying period needed by gypsum-based products.
cement-board-prefabricated-buildings.body2: For portable and relocatable buildings, the combination of lightweight (9.96 kg/m² at 12 mm) and structural rigidity reduces transportation weight while maintaining wall performance. The non-combustible classification (A1) is often required by regulations for temporary and site accommodation buildings.

cement-board-prefabricated-buildings.feature2: Non-combustible A1 — meets fire requirements for site accommodation
cement-board-prefabricated-buildings.feature3: No drying or curing period required — ready for finishing immediately
cement-board-prefabricated-buildings.feature4: Dimensionally stable — no movement during temperature cycling in unheated units
cement-board-prefabricated-buildings.feature5: Moisture resistant — survives transport and site installation exposure
cement-board-prefabricated-buildings.feature6: CE certified — required for permanent prefab buildings across the EEA

cement-board-interior-walls.title: Cement board for interior walls
cement-board-interior-walls.summary: Cement board as a high-performance interior wall lining and partition substrate — moisture rooms, commercial interiors, and fire-rated partitions.

cement-board-interior-walls.h1: Cement Board for Interior Wall Applications
cement-board-interior-walls.lead: Terasun TSM cement board is used as an interior wall lining and partition board where standard gypsum board is insufficient — in wet rooms, commercial interiors with high impact exposure, and fire-rated partition assemblies.
cement-board-interior-walls.body1: For standard dry interior partitions with no moisture or fire exposure, gypsum board is lighter, easier to cut, and lower in cost. Cement board is specified for interior walls where gypsum would fail: bathrooms, shower rooms, commercial kitchens, hospital corridors, and fire-rated compartmentation walls.
cement-board-interior-walls.body2: In interior wall systems, Terasun TSM provides significantly higher impact resistance than gypsum board — relevant in schools, hospitals, warehouses, and retail environments where wall damage from trolleys, equipment, and general use is a maintenance concern.

cement-board-interior-walls.feature2: Commercial kitchen wall substrate — splash zones and steam environments
cement-board-interior-walls.feature3: Hospital and healthcare — high impact, hygienic surface
cement-board-interior-walls.feature4: Fire-rated partition assembly — tested system E 120 / EI 90 / EW 120
cement-board-interior-walls.feature5: High-traffic corridors — higher impact resistance than gypsum
cement-board-interior-walls.feature6: Compatible with all standard tile adhesives, paints, and render finishes

cement-board-exterior-walls.summary: Cement board sheathing and cladding for exterior wall systems — render carrier, facade board, and weather-resistant wall substrate.

cement-board-exterior-walls.lead: Terasun TSM is classified EN 12467 Category A — confirming suitability for all exterior wall applications in European climate zones, from Nordic to Mediterranean conditions.
cement-board-exterior-walls.body1: Exterior wall board must remain dimensionally stable through freeze-thaw cycles, wind-driven rain, and temperature extremes. Terasun TSM cement board passes EN 12467 Category A moisture and durability tests — the highest classification for cement boards in European use. Unlike timber sheathing, it does not swell, rot, or lose structural integrity when wet.
cement-board-exterior-walls.body2: In exterior wall systems, Terasun TSM is used as: the outer cladding board in ventilated facade systems; the render carrier for mineral and silicone external plaster; and the sheathing board in steel frame and timber frame exterior wall assemblies.

cement-board-exterior-walls.feature2: Suitable for all European climate zones from Nordic to Mediterranean
cement-board-exterior-walls.feature3: Compatible with ventilated facade systems (CBSS / CBMV)

cement-board-exterior-walls.feature5: Non-combustible exterior sheathing — A1 reaction to fire
cement-board-exterior-walls.feature6: ETA 24/0895 and CE 1023-CPR-1565 P confirm exterior application performance

cement-board-renovation.summary: Lightweight cement board for renovation and refurbishment projects — facade upgrade, wet room retrofit, and fire-rated partition upgrade.

cement-board-renovation.metaDesc: Terasun TSM lightweight cement board for renovation projects. Facade refurbishment, wet room retrofit, fire partition upgrade. 9.96 kg/m², CE certified.
cement-board-renovation.h1: Cement Board for Renovation and Refurbishment Projects
cement-board-renovation.lead: Terasun TSM lightweight cement board is well-suited to renovation and refurbishment projects — its combination of low weight, moisture resistance, and fire performance makes it practical for facade upgrades, wet room retrofits, and fire partition improvements in existing buildings.
cement-board-renovation.body1: In facade refurbishment, the primary constraint is often structural capacity of the existing building. At 9.96 kg/m² at 12 mm, Terasun TSM imposes significantly less dead load than natural stone, terracotta, or ceramic tile alternatives — making it viable for facade upgrades where the original structure cannot carry heavier cladding.
cement-board-renovation.body2: For wet room renovations over existing substrates, Terasun TSM can be applied over concrete, masonry, or other stable substrates using tile adhesive or mechanical fixing. The slim board profile (6 mm available for renovation) minimises door clearance reduction and maintains existing floor levels.

cement-board-renovation.feature2: Available in thinner profiles for renovation where height and clearance matter
cement-board-renovation.feature3: Suitable over existing concrete, masonry, and stable substrates

eta.question: Postoji li Europska tehnička ocjena (ETA)?
eta.answer: Da. ETA 24/0895 izdana je od strane određenog tijela za ETA. Nezavisno potvrđuje karakteristike izvedbe proizvoda za njegove namjeravane upotrebe. Potpuna ETA dostupna je za preuzimanje.

epd.question: Postoji li EPD (Deklaracija o okolišnim svojstvima proizvoda)?
epd.answer: Da. EPD-IES-0018268, objavljena 14.03.2025., valjana do 14.03.2029. Sukladno ISO 14025. Deklarirana jedinica: 1 m² pri 12 mm, masa 9,96 kg/m². Podržava projekte certifikacije LEED, BREEAM i DGNB.

weight.question: Koja je deklarirana masa ploče?
weight.answer: Deklarirana masa prema EPD-IES-0018268 je 9,96 kg/m² pri 12 mm debljine. Tanje ploče su proporcionalno lakše. Potpuna tablica debljine/mase nalazi se u tehnološkom listu.

fire.question: Koju otpornost na požar postižu ploče?
fire.answer: Testirani sustav postižu E 120 (integritet 120 min), EI 90 (integritet i izolacija 90 min) i EW 120 (integritet i ograničenje toplinskog sjaja 120 min). Referenca testa: FIRES-CR-284-25-AUPE. To su klasifikacije na razini sustava — navedite konfiguraciju testiranog sustava.

wetroom.question: Mogu li se Terasun TSM ploče koristiti u mokrim prostorijama?
wetroom.answer: Da. Odobrena kao podložna ploča za pločice u Mapei i Schönox sustavima za mokre prostorije. Dimenzionalno stabilna, vlaknovita, otporna na vlagu podloga za kupaonice, tuše i komercijalne kuhinje.

facade.question: Može li se ploča koristiti za vanjsku oblogu fasade?
facade.answer: Da. Specificirana kao ploča fasade u CBSS i CBMV sustavima ventilirane fasade. Može se koristiti i kao nosač žbuke. Prikladna za sve europske klimatske zone.

asbestos.question: Je li ploča bez azbesta?
asbestos.answer: Da. Terasun TSM je potpuno bez azbesta. Ploča koristi portland cement s anorganskim vezivima i staklenim mrežastim ojačanjem. REACH SVHC izjava koja potvrđuje da nema SVHC iznad 0,1% w/w je dostupna.

moq.question: Koja je minimalna količina narudžbe?
moq.answer: Minimalna narudžba je obično jedan 20-stopni kontejner (približno 1.600–2.200 m² ovisno o debljini). Manje količine mogu biti dostupne iz finskih skladišnih zaliha. Kontaktirajte nas za dostupnost.

samples.question: Jesu li uzorci dostupni prije postavljanja narudžbe?
samples.answer: Da. Fizički uzorci i dokumentacijski paketi dostupni su kvalificiranim distributerima, arhitektima i izvođačima. Kontaktirajte nas da zatražite paket uzorka koji uključuje ploču, TDS, CE certifikat i ETA.

leadtime.question: Koliko dugo traje isporuka?
leadtime.answer: Narudžbe kontejnera traju približno 6–10 tjedana od potvrde narudžbe do isporuke na europsku luku. DDP isporuka u skladište dodaje 1–2 tjedana. Finska zaliha: 1–2 tjedana.

origin.question: Gdje se proizvod proizvodi?
origin.answer: Proizvodi Zhejiang Terasun Air Duct Co., Ltd. u provinciji Zhejiang, Narodnoj Republici Kini. Terasun Europe je Ovlašteni Europski Predstavnik odgovoran za CE dokumentaciju i sukladnost s tržištem EU.

whoIsTerasun.question: Što je Terasun Europe?
whoIsTerasun.answer: Terasun Europe je Ovlašteni Europski Predstavnik za Zhejiang Terasun Air Duct Co., Ltd., sa sjedištem u Vantaa, Finskoj. Upravljamo CE dokumentacijom, sukladnošću s tržištem EU i odnosima sa europskim kupcima. Nismo proizvođač Terasun proizvoda.

authorisation.question: Postoji li pismo o ovlaštenju od proizvođača?
authorisation.answer: Da. Službeno pismo o ovlaštenju od Zhejiang Terasun Air Duct Co., Ltd. koje potvrđuje Terasun Europe kao Ovlaštenog Europskog Predstavnika dostupno je za pregled.

distributor.question: Mogu li postati distributor u svojoj zemlji?
distributor.answer: Da. Aktivno tražimo distributere sa zalihama i projektne partnere diljem Europe. Sporazumi temeljeni na području, konkurentne marže, podrška dokumentaciji i tehnička obuka. Kontaktirajte nas za razgovor.

openMarkets.question: Koje su zemlje otvorene za distribuciju?
openMarkets.answer: Njemačka, Nizozemska, Belgija, Francuska, Španjolska, Portugalska, Italija, Austrija, Švicarska, Poljska, Češka Republika, Slovačka, Mađarska i ostale su otvorene za nove distribucijske partnere. Kontaktirajte nas za dostupnost teritorija.

studSpacing.question: Koji je potreban razmak između nosača?
studSpacing.answer: Kompatibilan sa razmakom od 400 mm i 600 mm u sustavima drvenih i čeličnih okvira. Specifične preporuke ovise o debljini ploče, orijentaciji i opterećenju — pogledajte tehnički list.

training.question: Dostupna je li tehnička obuka distributerima?
training.answer: Da. Tehnička obuka proizvoda, instalacijske smjernice i dokumentacijska podrška dostupne su registriranim distributerima. Obuka se može provesti na licu mjesta ili daljinski.

publicProjects.question: Može li se Terasun TSM koristiti na javnim i infrastrukturnim projektima?
publicProjects.answer: Da. CE, ETA, DoP, EPD i dokumentacija ispitivanja vatre ispunjavaju zahtjeve javne nabave u Europi. Dostupni su kompleti dokumentacije za specifikaciju i podnošenje ponude.

cuttingTools.question: Koji se rezni alati trebaju za instalaciju?
cuttingTools.answer: Terasun TSM može se rezati kružnom pilom ili kutnom brusilom opremljenom sa oštrinom za vlaknasti cement ili dijamantnom oštrinom. Označite i prelomite za ravne rezove na tanjim pločama. Nosite masku od prašine i zaštitu za oči. Detaljno uputstvo dostupno je u priručniku za instalaciju.

tools.title: Potrebni alati
tools.body: Kružna pila ili kutna brusilica s fibrocementnom pilicom, bušilica/odvijač, mjerna traka, kredna linija i OSB (maska od prašine, zaštitne naočale).

cutting.title: Metode rezanja
cutting.body: Rezanje s kružnom pilom (fibrocementna pilica) ili zarezi pa lomljenje za ravne rezove na tanjih ploča. Vlažno rezanje smanjuje prašinu.

fastening.title: Pričvršćivanje
fastening.body: Pričvrstite s nehrđajućim čeličnim ili otpornim na koroziju samoreznim vijcima ili ring čavlima. Min 12 mm razmak od ruba, 200 mm razmak ruba, 300 mm razmak polja.

joints.title: Spojevi i razmaci
joints.body: Ostavite 3 mm dilatacijski razmak na svim rubovima ploče. Zalijepite i popunite čeone spojeve za unutrašnjost. Za vanjsku stranu, ostavite otvorene spojeve s brtvom ili pokrijte specijalnim profilima spojeva.

weather.title: Zaštita od vremena
weather.body: Ne instalirujte u uvjetima zamrzavanja. Štitite ploče od kiše dok sustav nije zaštićen od vremena. Čuvajte pokriveno — ploče se ne smiju nalaziti u stoječoj vodi.

finishing.title: Završni radovi i boja
finishing.body: Temeljite s prajmerom otpornim na alkali prije farbanja ili žbuke. Kompatibilno s mineralnim, silikonskim i akrilnim završecima. Unutarnje površine mogu se direktno popločati polimernim ljepilom.
